title: Four and thirty
note: 1 August 1804, at the camp below the bluff, waiting on the Oto. It was Clark's thirty-fourth birthday. He ordered 'a Saddle of fat Vennison, an Elk fleece & a Bevertail to be cooked and a Desert of Cheries, Plumbs, Raspberries Currents and grapes'. That day Shields, Joseph Field and Gibson each killed a deer, an elk was killed, and a beaver was taken in Drouillard's trap. A fair day and a cool evening; the mosquitoes very troublesome.

lines.speaker: Clark
lines.text: The first of August. I am four and thirty today, Captain Lewis.

lines.speaker: York
lines.text: Then there ought to be a dinner, Captain Clark.

choices.label: Send the hunters out for his dinner
choices.note: Drouillard's traps are set on the creek; Shields, Joseph Field and Gibson are good shots.

choices.label: Send Pryor's mess along the bank for fruit
choices.note: Plums, cherries, currants and grapes grow thick on the bottom.

choices.label: No time for dinners; the Oto are looked for

effects.journal: Three deer and an elk killed today, and a large beaver taken in Drouillard's trap.

lines.speaker: Sgt. Ordway
lines.text: Three deer and an elk, Captain. And a beaver in Drouillard's trap, a big one.

choices.label: Send Pryor's mess for fruit as well

effects.journal: The hunters killed one deer, and that a poor one.

lines.speaker: Sgt. Ordway
lines.text: One deer, Captain, and not a fat one. The horses strayed and took half the morning finding.

lines.speaker: York
lines.text: Dinner's near ready at the fire, Captain.

dinner.hint: York has Clark's dinner at the fire

lines.speaker: Clark
lines.text: Well. Let us see what the day has come to.

choices.label: A saddle of fat venison, an elk fleece and a beaver tail, and a dessert of fruit

effects.journal: Captain Clark's birthday. A saddle of fat venison, an elk fleece and a beaver tail cooked, and a dessert of cherries, plums, raspberries, currants and grapes of a superior quality.
Captain Clark's birthday. Venison and a beaver tail for his dinner.

choices.label: Salt pork, and the fruit from the bank

effects.journal: Captain Clark's birthday. Pork, and plums and grapes gathered on the bottom.

choices.label: Salt pork, as any other day

effects.journal: Captain Clark's birthday, kept with the ordinary ration.

lines.speaker: Sgt. Ordway
lines.text: The men would drink the Captain's health, sir, if there was the means.

choices.label: An extra gill all round, for his health
choices.note: A gill a man is a gallon and a half out of the whiskey.

effects.journal: An extra gill to each man, to drink Captain Clark's health.

lines.speaker: Clark
lines.text: The mosquitoes are very troublesome tonight.
